body:
It was the day after New Years I had been partying that night and was in a happier mood. Earlier that day I had swiped a pill my brother took for ADD called ritalin I had 4 10 mg pills. Reluctantly I decided to take 2 just to see what it felt like. The half an hour before the effects would start was spent walking around my neighborhood with sweaty palms wondering what effects would follow the pill I had just induced. I felt a slight numbness and a need to talk to others and soon I had a mild but heavier numbness and a good feeling in my body. Since the effects were mild and pleasurable I decided to take 2 more. I went home right after that. When I got home all of the sudden a feeling of intense euphoria, power, and energy overcame me. I had a huge need to talk to someone so I went to the closest person possible, my brother (whom I rarely talk nice of or am nice to). I started to talk to him  to my surprise a feeling of somehow being connected to him arose and I was actually able to have an in depth conversation with him. I figured if I could talk to him like this what would I act like around my friends. So I called some and had more great conversations. I had become this ultra funny and lovable guy while on this. Later on that night I got to be paranoid and would not talk to others for fear of them knowing I am on this medication (?). I went to bed that night but did not sleep a wink I just sat there staring into black emptiness while thoughts in my head raced by. The next day I had still not gone to sleep but was still energized so I went through school. I found all my classes surprisingly easy and the day went by fairly fast. Finally later that evening I must have fallen asleep but I woke up 13  hours after my last memory and I was in my bed. I had been awake a total of 44 hours.
Though this experience scared me the next day I decided to take more so I could go back to that wonderful place. I only took 2 10 mg pills but the effects seemed to be the same with no insomnia or paranoia. I felt so great so powerful I would tell my friends I could lift a car no problem.
This went on for over a month and I began to develop a habit and addiction of it. One day before school I told myself my tolerance has raised lets take 4 before school so I did and everything seemed to be on the same level as when I took 2. When I got home I took 4 more because I felt my tolerance had risen. I did that for 4 days straight and soon became extremely irritable and agitated. My friend who noticed a problem with me told me I had to stop. So I did.... for then. Every day I told her I needed some more and I went into a depression she finally said OK fine break our promise and take some. So first thing I did when I got home from school that day is take some speed. This time it was something different a drug my friend's sister used called adderall. The potency of Adderall is much greater than ritalin and I soon began to use that every other day.
The use of this drug opened up a whole world of drugs to me including DXM, inhalants, nutmeg, motion sickness pills, codeine basically anything I can find to get high. I never seem to be satisfied though.
I still take it in fact even while I write this right now Im on it. Though I know Im going to need to stop I dont want to. It has gotten to the point where I used all my brothers ritalin and Im breaking into my friends house to steal adderall. I write this story because I was unaware of the dependence possibilities of these drugs and I would like to warn other about the danger of this drug. I will get off of this it has cost me a lot. I have a feeling from that day when I first took it till the day I die when I get sad or mad or upset or just want to have a good time the first word to pop in my head will be speed.
